task: [.github/workflows/research-learner.yml] .github/workflows/research-learner.yml iş akışındaki 85 saniyelik darboğazı gidermek için; Pip ve APT paket kurulum adımlarına `actions/cache` eklenerek tekrarlayan paket indirmeleri engellenmeli, workflow tetikleyicisine `paths` filtresi eklenerek ilgisiz dosya değişikliklerinde adımların çalışması önlenmeli ve birbiriyle bağımsız test adımları ayrı job'lara bölünerek paralel yürütülmelidir.

evidence.description: Workflow file identified for optimization by adding Pip/APT caching, paths trigger filtering, and job parallelization to address an 85-second bottleneck.

factual_findings: The target workflow is located at `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` and has an 85-second execution bottleneck.
Pip and APT dependencies are downloaded repeatedly without leveraging persistent caching mechanisms.
Workflow triggers lack `paths` restrictions, causing execution on irrelevant file modifications.
Independent test tasks are executed sequentially within a single job instead of running in parallel.
hypotheses: Integrating `actions/cache` (or `setup-python` built-in caching and APT caching) into `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` will eliminate redundant package downloads.
Adding `paths` filters to workflow triggers in `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` will reduce unnecessary job invocations.
Splitting sequential test steps into separate jobs running in parallel will reduce overall workflow wall-clock time.
result.recommendation: Refactor `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` to include `paths` filter under trigger definitions, add caching steps for Pip (`cache: 'pip'`) and APT packages via `actions/cache`, and separate independent test steps into distinct parallel jobs.
result.next_action: Read and edit `.github/workflows/research-learner.yml` to implement the caching, trigger path filters, and parallel job structures.
